lesson_title: R1 100 a Month to Get to Work
hook_text: How much does it cost to get to work if your taxi fare is R25?
clip_script: Not R25. You travel there and back, so that is R50 a day. Twenty-two working days a month makes R1 100. On a wage of R5 500, that is one fifth of everything you earn. Why is the trip so long? Under apartheid, many black South Africans were moved to townships far from city jobs. Today minibus taxis carry most commuters, buses with their own lanes skip the traffic, and trains carry huge crowds when they run. Cars? Comfortable, but costly and crowded.
visual_style: A whiteboard map of a city with a distant township, a taxi, bus and train racing to the CBD, and a wallet emptying R50 a day.
pacing: Builds from the fare calculation to the history.
